name: 턱선 일관성 분석
description: Analyzes jaw boundary smoothness and consistency
algorithm: Jawline Consistency — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes jawline characteristics for video deepfake detection:

1. **Jawline윤곽추적**: The mandibular contour is tracked per frame using facial landmarks from chin point through jaw angles to ear attachment points. The contour is parameterized by curvature, angular measurements at the gonial angle, and chin shape.

2. **턱-NeckTransition분석**: The boundary where the jaw meets the neck is a critical deepfake artifact zone. Natural jaw-neck transitions show anatomically correct tissue layering (skin, platysma muscle, subcutaneous fat). The method analyzes this transition for blending artifacts, color discontinuities, or unnatural sharp/smooth boundaries.

3. **턱동작Biomechanics**: During speech, the mandible rotates on the temporomandibular joint with specific biomechanical constraints (hinge + sliding motion, maximum opening ~40mm). The method verifies that jaw motion during speech follows these constraints. Deepfakes may produce jaw motion that violates TMJ biomechanics.

4. **Jawline대칭성일관성**: Mandibular asymmetry is a stable individual characteristic. The method tracks left-right jawline correspondence across frames — the asymmetry pattern should remain constant. Deepfakes may produce varying jaw asymmetry as the generator independently renders each frame.

5. **Jawline해상도평가**: The jawline is often at the boundary of the face-swap region. The method compares rendering quality of the jawline itself versus adjacent regions — resolution drops, texture quality changes, or sharpness discontinuities at the jawline indicate the edge of a generated face region.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through jawline consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
